This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is filed by the petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 8 challenging the FIR in Crime No.67/2022, registered by the Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC along with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

02. The summary of the FIR is that, respondent No.2 - de-facto complainant is the legally wedded wife of accused No.1, accused Nos.2 and 3 are the parents-in-law and other accused are relatives of husband, have subjected the respondent No.2 - de-facto complainant to cruelty both physically and mentally and demanded to bring money from her parental home.

03. The accused Nos.1 and 8 and the de-facto - complainant are present before this Court and they have filed an application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. stating that during pendency of the petition,
the marriage of the NC: 2023:KHC-K:1282 accused No.1 with the de-facto complainant has been dissolved mutually.
In terms of settlement, the de-facto - complainant has no objection for quashing the impunged proceedings.
04. The said application is placed on record.

05. The offences alleged against the accused are non-bailable, however, having regard to the fact, the parties have settled their dispute, it would be a futile exercise if the accused are subject to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak.
Hence, the continuation of the criminal proceedings against the accused, will be an abuse of process of law.

The impugned FIR in Crime No.67/2022 registered by the Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC along with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, against all the accused persons, is hereby quashed, in view of the settlement arrived between the parties.
